nodes.label: Anthropic Tool Runner
nodes.context: The agent loop driver from anthropic Python SDK. Tool runner exposes no before/after hooks, so wrapping tools as guarded functions is the integration seam.

nodes.label: ToolSpec
nodes.context: Frozen dataclass holding tool's name, description, JSON schema, callable, allowed_fields as frozenset. Immutable configuration per tool. Phase 1 Task 2.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.context: Holds ToolSpec per tool. Supports add/remove while running. Renders tool list to Tool Runner. Methods: add, remove, get, names (sorted), to_tool_params. Phase 1 Tasks 3-4.

nodes.label: Scope Gate
nodes.context: Permission enforcer running first in guard. Flattens alert to path->value. Refuses calls carrying restricted values before tool executes. Matching rules: normalize, short-values whole-argument-only, shared-values permitted, empty values never match.

nodes.label: flatten
nodes.context: Function producing flat dict with dotted paths to every leaf value. Converts values to strings. Key for scope gate value-matching.

nodes.label: check_scope
nodes.context: Raises ScopeViolation if tool call carries restricted values. Returns None if in scope. Integrates flatten and matching rules. Phase 2 Tasks 10-11.

nodes.label: ScopeViolation
nodes.context: Exception subclass with attributes tool and fields. Raised when call carries restricted values. Message names tool and every restricted field found.

nodes.label: Credibility Tracker
nodes.context: Runs after tool in guard. Applies exponential moving average. Store holds score per tool. Persists to JSON atomically between runs. Phase 3 Tasks 12-14.

nodes.label: CredibilityStore
nodes.context: Holds moving-average score per tool. Methods: get (returns INITIAL=1.0 for unknown), record (returns before/after scores). Persists/loads from JSON with atomic write. Phase 3 Tasks 13-14.

nodes.label: update
nodes.context: Pure function: score = max(FLOOR, (1-ALPHA)*score + ALPHA*outcome). Outcome 1.0 for success, 0.0 for failure. One failure costs 1/5 from full trust. Phase 3 Task 12.

nodes.label: Conflict Resolver
nodes.context: Normalizes tool results into claims (dimension, verdict, credibility). Resolves conflicts by comparing credibility. Above 0.15 gap: more credible wins, loser marked overridden. At/below gap: needs_human.

nodes.label: Decision Rule
nodes.context: Pure function from resolved claims to verdict. Evaluated in order: unresolved conflict->needs_human, surviving risk claim->escalate, otherwise->clear. Verdict produced by code, not model.

nodes.label: Audit Trail
nodes.context: Records every tool call: name, arguments, scope verdict, execution time, result/error, credibility before/after. Written as JSON alongside decision.

nodes.label: Guarded Tool Pattern
nodes.context: Wrapping function around each tool that: 1) checks scope and refuses if restricted, 2) runs tool and times it, 3) records success/failure with credibility, 4) returns JSON result or raises ToolError. Phase 4.

nodes.label: ToolError
nodes.context: anthropic.lib.tools.ToolError. Expected failures (scope violations, timeouts) raised as ToolError get only message to model, not stack trace. Prevents log noise.

nodes.label: sanctions_screen
nodes.context: Simulated tool returning watchlist match result. Returns {hit: bool, matches: list, lists_checked: list}. Reliable. Reports no match for fixture customer. Scope: customer.name, customer.country, customer.date_of_birth.

nodes.label: adverse_media_search
nodes.context: Simulated tool for negative news search. Returns {articles: list, adverse_count: int}. Fails on first call (timeout), succeeds on retry. Factory-built to maintain per-instance failure counter. Scope: customer.name, customer.country (NOT national_id).

nodes.label: transaction_graph
nodes.context: Returns counterparties and their flags. Returns {counterparties: list, flagged_count: int}. Reports link to flagged entity (Vantage Freight OU). Scope: customer.customer_id only.

nodes.label: risk_score
nodes.context: Composite risk scoring tool. Returns {score: 0-100, band: low|medium|high}. Requires other three tool results as input. Formula: min(100, 10 + (50 if sanctions_hit else 0) + 10*adverse_count + 20*flagged_counterparties). Scope: empty (no alert fields).

nodes.label: build_registry
nodes.context: Function constructing fully-populated Registry with four ToolSpec objects. Creates fresh adverse_media_search tool on each call to avoid state leakage. Phase 1 Task 8.

nodes.label: ToolTimeoutError
nodes.context: RuntimeError subclass raised by adverse_media_search. Stands in for transient network failure. Used to demonstrate tool retry path and credibility recovery.

nodes.label: Customer Risk Dimension
nodes.context: Conflicts arise on same dimension: what question the claim addresses. sanctions_screen vs transaction_graph both claim on customer risk but contradict each other. Phase 5 resolver settles by credibility.

nodes.label: Alert Fixture (alert-001.json)
nodes.context: Single flagged transaction alert: ALRT-2026-0917 for Marek Dvorak (CZ-760415-2231) transacting with Vantage Freight OU (EE). Used throughout test suite deterministically.

nodes.label: Value-Based Permission Matching
nodes.context: Gate matches on argument values, not names. ID number is leak whether in name, query, or free-text. Flattens alert to paths, checks if value appears in call arguments at any nesting depth.

nodes.label: Normalized Comparison Rule
nodes.context: Values compared lowercased with non-alphanumeric stripped. CZ-760415-2231 and cz 760415 2231 both become cz7604152231. Prevents reformatting bypass.

nodes.label: Short Values Whole-Argument-Only Rule
nodes.context: Restricted value under 4 normalized chars (MIN_SUBSTRING_LENGTH=4) like EE matches only when argument equals it outright, not inside words. Prevents false positives in free text.

nodes.label: Shared Values Permitted Rule
nodes.context: Restricted field with same value as allowed field (customer and counterparty in same country) is permitted. Gate cannot distinguish which was meant, so refuses would block legitimate calls.

nodes.label: Exponential Moving Average
nodes.context: score = max(FLOOR, (1-ALPHA)*score + ALPHA*outcome). Alpha=0.2, floor=0.1, initial=1.0. Recent behavior weighted more. Single failure doesn't destroy standing; recoverable distrust.

nodes.label: Atomic JSON Persistence
nodes.context: Credibility scores saved atomically: write to temp file next to target, then os.replace onto real path. Ensures file always either old or new version, never half-written.

nodes.label: Test-First Development
nodes.context: Tests written first, then implementation. Phase 1 and 2-3 plans show complete test code before implementation. Author writes implementation by hand as learning exercise.

nodes.label: Frozen Dataclass Immutability
nodes.context: ToolSpec frozen so credibility scores kept separate in CredibilityStore, not mutated on spec. Configuration and state have different lifecycles. Prevents accidental mutation.

nodes.label: Factory Pattern for Stateful Tool
nodes.context: make_adverse_media_search factory returns closure with own call counter. Ensures every instance has fresh state, avoiding leakage between tests/runs. Module-level counter would fail.

nodes.label: Credibility Gap Threshold
nodes.context: 0.15 threshold for conflict resolution. Gap above: winner declared, loser marked overridden. Gap at or below: case resolves to needs_human (no winner).

nodes.label: National ID Leak Scenario
nodes.context: Model passes customer's national ID (CZ-760415-2231) to adverse_media_search seeking matches. Gate refuses before tool runs. Model retries with name/country only. Real privacy failure that scope gate prevents.

nodes.label: Retry on Transient Failure
nodes.context: adverse_media_search times out on first call, succeeds on retry. Credibility goes 1.0 -> 0.8 (failure) -> 0.84 (recovery). Demonstrates score is recoverable, not permanent distrust.

nodes.label: needs_human Outcome
nodes.context: First-class resolution outcome when conflict gap is at/below credibility threshold. Declining to decide is better than near-arbitrary automation. Escalates to human reviewer.

nodes.label: Scope Violations Raised as ToolError
nodes.context: Expected failures (scope violations, timeouts) raised as anthropic.lib.tools.ToolError reach model as is_error result with message only, no stack trace. Prevents log noise.

nodes.label: Sorted Registry Names
nodes.context: Registry.names() returns sorted list. Stable tool list for prompt caching (keys on exact prefix). Registration order doesn't change cached prefix.

nodes.label: Verdict Produced by Code
nodes.context: Decision rule produces verdict from resolved claims, not model. Model writes narrative explaining case. Regulated decision must be reproducible and auditable on demand.

nodes.label: Model Configuration
nodes.context: claude-opus-5 with adaptive thinking. Chosen for multi-tool orchestration capability.

nodes.label: Open Question: Real Contradiction Format
nodes.context: Current conflict (sanctions vs graph on customer risk) not a real contradiction. Recommendation: use name-match false positive where sanctions_screen matches by name, transaction_graph by registration number. Both true but contradictory.

nodes.label: Open Question: Counterparty Screening Scope
nodes.context: sanctions_screen declared scope doesn't include counterparty. But screening counterparties is standard practice. Recommended: add counterparty.name and counterparty.country to allowed_fields.

nodes.label: Out of Scope: Fallback to Different Tool
nodes.context: Deliberately deferred v1 feature. Requires two tools covering same capability. With four distinct tools, nothing to fall back to. Retrying same tool is implemented.
nodes.norm_label: out of scope: fallback to different tool

nodes.label: Ponytail Ceiling: Encoded Values
nodes.context: Known scope gate limitation: encoded or partially transcribed values (base64 ID, last four digits) will not match. Deliberate v1 ceiling, recorded in code with upgrade path.
